mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM srv_inspection_detection_result r INNER JOIN ( SELECT rule_snapshot_id, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM srv_inspection_detection_result WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND attempt_id = #{query.attemptId} AND deleted = b'0' GROUP BY rule_snapshot_id ) latest ON latest.latest_id = r.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.attempt_id = #{query.attemptId} AND r.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY r.device_id,r.rule_snapshot_id
